description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_GetTags, which implements a method for retrieving all tags used in a Smarty template, used as part of Smarty's internal plugin system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetTags
classes.description: Implements the getTags method to retrieve all tags used by a Smarty template, handling different input object types and template sources.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Retrieves an array of tags and their attributes used within a Smarty template, handling different template object inputs and throwing exceptions if the template cannot be loaded.
